description: The one Capture window. Rust opens it on Capture's AppData root, whose settings.md the page reads (openAppData from @epicenter/folder/tauri, which finds it with Tauri's path API); the page then opens its data folder by path (openDataFolder): the folder settings.md names, or ~/Epicenter/<productName> (the app's name, core:app:allow-name), which Rust allows in Tauri's runtime file-system scope at startup. Any other folder opens only once the native picker (dialog:allow-open) allowed it; persisted-scope keeps that across launches. No capability names a folder. On close it waits for queued writes, then destroys the window. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does.
